titles.romaji: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - THE BEYOND
titles.native: 蒼穹のファフナー Dead Aggressor THE BEYOND

description:
The people of Alvis need Soushi's help, since he is the only one that can lead them back to their homeland of Tatsumiyajima, however a group called Benon, who are a combination of Festum and Perseus-type Fafner's, are fighting to prevent this.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
